folderCompare.title: Folder Compare
folderCompare.description: Compare two local folders and find differences using MD5 hash or file size comparison.
folderCompare.shortDescription: Compare two folders to find differences
folderCompare.longDescription: This tool allows you to compare two local folders using the File System Access API. You can compare files by MD5 hash (most accurate) or by file size (faster). The tool will show you files that are added, removed, modified, or unchanged between the two folders.
folderCompare.computingHashes: Computing MD5 hashes. This may take a while for large files...
folderCompare.compareByMd5Description: Most accurate comparison, but slower for large files
folderCompare.errorSelectingFolder: Error selecting folder. Please try again.
folderCompare.errorComparing: Error comparing folders. Please try again.

toolInfo.title: How to Use Folder Compare
toolInfo.description: Select two folders from your local filesystem. Choose between MD5 hash comparison (accurate but slow) or file size comparison (fast but less accurate). Click Compare to see the differences between the two folders.
